evidence_level: L3 real-pretrained nonlinear MLP component diagnostic; not end-to-end model quality
hypothesis: one trained full-rank nonlinear MLP can serve several logical depths with only tiny depth-specific FiLM scale vectors

protocol.calibration: WikiText-2 raw train; 128 teacher MLP input/output rows per logical layer
protocol.evaluation: disjoint WikiText-2 raw test; 64 held-out rows per logical layer
protocol.shared_matrix_initialization: arithmetic mean of teacher MLP matrices in each depth group
protocol.loss: mean of per-logical-layer normalized MLP-output MSE
protocol.depth_conditioning: FP16 scale_in[576] + scale_mid[1536] + scale_out[576] per logical layer
protocol.packed_representation: Q4_GROUP64 shared gate/up/down + FP16 FiLM scales; no independent dense logical MLP shadows

substantive_decision.reason: Both sharing spans retain approximately 92-94% normalized held-out MLP-output error after function-space training. The FP32 trained ceilings and Q4-packed results are nearly identical, so quantization is not the bottleneck. Even sharing only five neighboring logical MLPs fails badly, while the ten-layer arm's 9.63x byte economics do not translate into function fidelity.

interpretation.ruled_out: the tested post-hoc local function-distillation recipe using one shared full-rank MLP plus only diagonal FiLM depth conditioning
interpretation.not_ruled_out: architectures jointly pretrained or globally distilled with shared/recurrent MLPs, or materially richer layer-specific conditioning learned during full-model training
interpretation.next_structural_implication: If structural reuse is required by the Run-12 Q4-relative information bound, it should be introduced during joint model training/distillation rather than by local post-hoc MLP fitting.

claim_boundary: Real-pretrained isolated MLP function diagnostic only. The 9.63x figure is MLP-pool Q4_GROUP64 byte reduction, not total-model or Q4_K_M reduction. No end-to-end PPL, task accuracy, native runtime, RSS, or VRAM claim.
